data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly demands a single mechanism that best explains why the night-time UHI gap is larger in some cities than in others. The target presents SVF/radiative trapping, thermal-mass release, anthropogenic heat, and evapotranspiration as co-equal contributors with no decisive argument or evidence that one uniquely dominates the inter-city variance, and even lists overturn conditions under which thermal mass, evapotranspiration, or population density would dominate instead. This leaves the requested 'single best' mechanism undetermined.
